channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Nunes Marques: TSE não tem nenhuma participação na alteração dos locais de votação
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kássio Nunes Marques, stated that the court has no involvement in changing voting locations. He emphasized the judiciary's independence in this matter.

item.title: Lula vai propor direcionar 25% das emendas obrigatórias para financiar tarifa zero
item.description: President Lula proposes a constitutional amendment to allocate 25% of mandatory budget amendments to fund free urban public transport on weekends, fulfilling a campaign promise.

item.title: Flávio pede ao STF acesso a inquérito sobre lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: The lawyers of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed a petition at the Supreme Federal Court to access the investigation in which he is suspected of money laundering. The case is under review by Minister Alexandre de Moraes and involves lawyer Willer Tomaz de Souza.

item.title: Campanha de Lula lança novo jingle: “Flávio, abre o sigilo”
item.description: Lula's campaign released a jingle urging Flávio Bolsonaro to open his bank, tax, and phone records during events in Juazeiro and Petrolina. The move aims for greater transparency after Lula authorized the release of his own and his family's sealed information.

item.title: PF pede mais prazo para aprofundar investigações sobre Lulinha e Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: The Federal Police requested an extension to deepen investigations into Fábio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and Roberta Luchsinger, accused of influence trafficking. The inquiries, analyzed by the STF, investigate alleged intermediation of contracts with public power. The defenses have not yet commented.

item.title: TSE ouve Meta e campanhas de Flávio e Lula sobre distribuição de conteúdo
item.description: The TSE held a meeting with Meta and the campaigns of Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula to ensure transparency and equality in content distribution and advertising, particularly regarding AI-generated content. Meta was ordered to treat both campaigns equally following accusations of censorship against Lula's campaign.

item.title: Gilmar e Hugo Motta defendem preservação das instituições democráticas na reta final do segundo turno
item.description: Gilmar Mendes and Hugo Motta defended the preservation of democratic institutions and the Rule of Law following the presidential runoff, emphasizing dialogue between government branches and the integrity of the electoral system. Both highlighted the importance of the 1988 Constitution and society in keeping Brazilian democracy strong and resilient.

item.title: Presidente do TSE diz que mudanças em locais de votação do primeiro para o segundo turno caíram em relação a 2022
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, reported that changes to voting locations between the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections decreased by 94% compared to 2022. He emphasized that these adjustments are decided by regional electoral courts, not the TSE. He also noted that data may be updated until election day in case of unforeseen circumstances.

item.title: Petistas fazem bullying com Felca no Dia de Combate ao Bullying
item.description: Influencer Felca released a video about social phobia and bullying he experienced in school, coinciding with the Anti-Bullying Day. Lulista supporters used the content to attack Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming that PT militants had bullied Felca.

item.title: Lula visita Sarney após ato no Maranhão; veja fotos
item.description: President Lula visited former President José Sarney in São Luís after a campaign walk in Maranhão, three days after Sarney was discharged following surgery. The visit included First Lady Janja and reinforced regional alliances ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Gilmar diz que democracia brasileira serve de exemplo ao mundo
item.description: Justice Minister Gilmar Mendes emphasized the strength of Brazilian democracy at the opening of the 29th International Congress of Constitutional Law of IDP, stating that Brazil serves as an example to the world and highlighting society's role in preserving democratic achievements. He also addressed the electoral process, describing it as a symbolic moment for democracy, and noted challenges such as the full implementation of social rights outlined in the 1988 Constitution.

item.title: PF diz que amigo de Flávio Bolsonaro pagou por remoção de notícias
item.description: Federal Police investigate lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, for allegedly paying a company to remove news articles about both from search results. The case is part of an investigation filed with the Supreme Federal Court under Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The probe suggests an online content manipulation operation.

item.title: Meta manipula o algoritmo? Especialista desmonta a tese do PT
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit at the TSE accusing Meta of algorithmic manipulation favoring Flávio Bolsonaro, requesting the annulment of the PL ticket. Meta denies any algorithmic bias. The MST also protested against the company during the same week the story broke.

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro apaga publicações contra o Bolsa Família
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro deleted old posts criticizing the Bolsa Família program and linking it to vote-buying. The posts, from 2010 to 2014, were recovered from an archive and used by Lula allies to question the PL candidate's shift in stance. The deletion comes amid controversy over statements by his campaign team.

item.title: Por que a “quebra de sigilo” de Lula no TSE não tem valor jurídico
item.description: President Lula filed authorization to break his own bank, tax, and phone confidentiality, along with family members, conditional on Flávio Bolsonaro doing the same. Despite the move, the act has no legal value, since breaking confidentiality requires a judicial decision, not unilateral authorization.

item.title: Entidades pedem ao Congresso dos EUA investigação sobre atuação da Meta na eleição brasileira
item.description: Five Brazilian civil society organizations requested the U.S. Congress to investigate Meta's role, owner of Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, during the Brazilian elections. The letter was submitted on Tuesday (20), raising concerns about the influence of digital platforms on the electoral process. The initiative seeks transparency regarding the role of social media in the campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede a Alexandre de Moraes, do STF, acesso a inquérito sobre suspeitas de lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense requested access to an inquiry into money laundering suspicions involving the senator, lawyer Willer Tomaz, and affiliated companies. The investigation, moved to the STF due to privileged jurisdiction, reveals millionaire financial flows and a possible de facto business link between the candidate and one investigated firm.

item.title: Conselho da Meta aponta erros na moderação de conteúdo eleitoral
item.description: Meta's Oversight Board identified flaws in electoral content moderation across its platforms, highlighting inconsistencies in rule enforcement during campaigns in Brazil and the US. The report calls for greater transparency and consistency in moderation decisions during electoral processes.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro propõe cashback de Pix e retomada do Perse
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign proposes 'vira Pix', a cashback mechanism to partially refund Pix payments, without providing details on costs or implementation. It also announces the reinstatement of Perse, a program supporting the events sector created during the pandemic and later discontinued in 2025 due to criticism over its high fiscal cost and fraud allegations.

item.title: Doações a Flávio quase triplicam no 2º turno e chegam a 26 vezes o valor recebido por Lula
item.description: Donations to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign nearly tripled in the second round, reaching R$20.3 million, 26 times the amount received by Lula. This significant increase indicates strong financial backing for the PL candidate in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Em carta aos católicos, Lula pede "voto motivado pela verdade e respeito"
item.description: Lula releases a letter asking for votes motivated by truth, respect, and justice, highlighting social policies, poverty reduction, and the fight against hunger, unemployment, and lack of healthcare. Dated October 12, the Day of Our Lady of Aparecida, the reelection candidate urges Catholics to examine their choice in light of conscience, faith, values, and the lived reality of Brazilians. He states that the election defines the national project and that politics must serve popular needs, not hatred or privilege.

item.title: Tropa do Flávio emplaca termo no X; Exército do Lula reage para derrubar
item.description: The Tropa do Flávio channel, with 2 million followers, promoted the hashtag 'NÃO CALEM OS NORDESTINOS' on X, responding to a video by federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticizing President Lula. Hours later, the Lula Army, led by André Janones, retaliated with the hashtag #NordestinosComLula and quickly overtook the opposing movement. The clash occurred after an Instagram video lost its audio, the reason for which remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Marçal diz que vai sugerir a Flávio abrir o sigilo se Lula divulgar gastos
item.description: Pablo Marçal said he will speak with Flávio Bolsonaro to accept Lula's challenge on opening bank and phone secrecy, proposing the disclosure of federal government spending. The Barueri event gathered 400 digital influencers and political allies to strengthen Flávio's campaign in the final stretch.

item.title: Vereador é gravado imobilizando companheira com violência no interior de SP
item.description: Vereador Júnior Féfin (União Brasil) from Marília (SP) was recorded on video violently restraining his girlfriend, holding her neck with his legs while she asked him to stop. The victim sought medical attention and went to the police, but did not file a report. The City Council has not commented.

item.title: Em Goiás, Flávio Bolsonaro recebe apoio de mais de 30 cantores sertanejos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro received support from over 30 sertanejo singers in Goiânia, where he highlighted violence, taxes, and debt as key national challenges. He promised economic and public safety improvements during the event, criticizing Lula's administration. The gathering was organized by Wilder Morais, who lost to the MDB in his state race.

item.title: Campanha de Lula corre contra o tempo após dormir no ponto e aposta em erro de Flávio na última hora
item.description: Lula’s campaign, after underestimating Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round, makes a last-ditch effort to pressure the opponent into revealing financial and phone records. The strategy includes allegations against Meta for algorithmic manipulation and revives a historical controversy by referencing Cristovam Buarque’s 1998 defeat after a televised humiliation.

item.title: Gay “vai poder dar o caneco” se eu for presidente, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), presidential candidate, stated in a video that gays will be able to have sex without persecution under his government, reinforcing he will not interfere in people's private lives. He emphasized focus on security and economy, ensuring LGBTQIA+ civil rights will remain unchanged.

item.title: Lula condiciona debate na “Globo” à abertura de sigilo de Flávio
item.description: Lula conditions a Globo debate on Flávio Bolsonaro opening his financial and phone records. During a campaign event in Juazeiro, he linked transparency to investigations of potential irregularities, supported by protesters demanding access to documents. The TSE request requires mutual disclosure, with a response deadline on Wednesday.

item.title: Campanha de Lula cobra checagem ao vivo em debate com Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign demands live fact-checking during the presidential debates and conditions his participation on Flávio's authorization to break his bank, fiscal, and phone secrecy. Senator Camilo Santana criticized Flávio's performance in the last debate and advocates for mechanisms to verify the candidates' statements.

item.title: Após alta, Janones compara Lula a Messi e mira mobilização de indecisos
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) was discharged after hospitalization for cardiac arrhythmia and stated he will resume digital mobilization in support of Lula. He compared Lula to Messi and emphasized focusing on undecided voters and non-voters in the final stretch of the campaign.

item.title: Lula anuncia envio de PEC para transporte gratuito nos fins de semana
item.description: President Lula announced sending a constitutional amendment proposal (PEC) to establish free public transport on weekends and holidays, with gradual implementation starting with municipal buses and partial funding through parliamentary amendments. Linked to workers' expanded rest period, the measure still requires congressional approval and is estimated to cost 16 billion reais annually.

item.title: Nikolas e Janones têm alta no engajamento depois do 1º turno
item.description: Following the first round of the 2026 elections, Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) and André Janones (Rede-MG) saw significant increases in digital engagement, rising by 514% and 272%, respectively. A report by Casa Galileia and Instituto Democracia em Xeque highlights them as key figures in the campaigns of Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The digital warfare in the second round, particularly on WhatsApp and through groups like 'Exército do Lula', has intensified the online battle.

item.title: Flávio disse que quantidade de beneficiários do Bolsa Família era 'para se envergonhar'
item.description: In 2014, Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the high number of Bolsa Família beneficiaries, stating the data 'should shame Brazil before the world'. His remarks highlighted concerns about state dependency and Brazil's international image. The comment resurfaced recently, sparking debates on social policies.

item.title: Camilo cobra checagem de fatos em tempo real no debate da Globo entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: Camilo Santana, campaign coordinator for Lula, called for real-time fact-checking during the TV Globo debate between Lula and Flávio. He emphasized the importance of combating misinformation during the televised debate.

item.title: Lula vai pedir anulação da candidatura de Flávio por "interferência" da Meta
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) requested the annulment of Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential candidacy, accusing Meta of improper interference in the electoral process. The move was announced on Tuesday (20) as part of Lula's strategy to challenge political opponents.

item.title: Kotscho: Flávio tem muito a explicar, e nada será esclarecido se eleito
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has many explanations to give about the revenue of his law office, and the investigation may not proceed if he is elected, according to columnist Ricardo Kotscho on UOL News.

item.title: MPF investiga suposta intimidação a manifestantes em atos anti-Lula no RN
item.description: The Federal Public Ministry (MPF) has opened an investigation following a disturbance at an anti-Lula rally in Rio Grande do Norte, where protesters were allegedly intimidated at federal educational institutions. The action aims to investigate possible incidents of hostility against the rally participants.

item.title: Bruno Engler diz que pode ser eleito presidente da ALMG: "Sem a esquerda"
item.description: Bruno Engler (PL) stated he can be elected president of ALMG without left-wing support, emphasizing center-right majority. He mentioned discussions with the caucus and potential alliances, including with Doorgal Andrada (PP). Engler participated in an event supporting Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Perse para shows x Rouanet: entenda as diferenças entre os programas de incentivo à cultura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposes restoring Perse, a tax incentive program for the events sector, highlighting differences with the Rouanet Law, which supports cultural projects through income tax exemptions. Perse was terminated in 2025 after reaching the $15 billion cap and facing suspicions of irregularities such as money laundering and misuse of benefits. The Rouanet Law, already in place, reached a record fundraising of $3.41 billion in 2025.

item.title: PT diz ter 100 assinaturas por CPMI contra Flávio por Dark Horse e advogado
item.description: The PT leads an initiative with over 100 parliamentarians, including support from PSD, PSB and Podemos, to establish a CPI investigating the financing of the film 'Dark Horse' and the relationship between Flávio Bolsonaro and Willer Tomaz. The strategy aims to pressure the opponent during the campaign and promote transparency, while Lula proposes opening bank secrecy in the TV debate. The opposition also seeks support for a CPI on Fábio Luís Lula and Roberta Luchsinger.

item.title: Lula pede que idosos façam do voto uma “questão de honra”
item.description: Lula urged elderly voters to treat voting as a 'matter of honor' in the runoff and called for mobilizing those who did not vote in the first round. During Northeast rallies, he emphasized national sovereignty, criticized U.S. subordination, and highlighted regional initiatives like the São Francisco river transposition. He also challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to disclose his bank and phone records.

item.title: Marçal diz que eleitor de Renan Santos ‘põe o voto onde quiser’
item.description: Pablo Marçal, an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, stated in a podcast that Renan Santos' voters can cast their ballots wherever they want, after Santos decided not to endorse any candidate. The remark sparked discussion about electoral alliances.

item.title: Tropa do Flávio cobra Rubel após vídeo de Nikolas perder áudio
item.description: The Flávio Troop, a support group for Flávio Bolsonaro, mobilized supporters to criticize singer Rubel after the audio of a video by federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira was removed, allegedly at his request to Sony. The video, which garnered over 83 million views, used the song 'Grão de Areia' by Rubel and Xande de Pilares, and featured testimonials from Northeast residents about challenges under President Lula's government. Nikolas publicly questioned Rubel’s actions, accusing him of silencing voices supportive of the PT.

item.title: Itamaraty repudia declarações de Milei e fala em “ingerência externa”
item.description: Itamaraty rejected Argentine President Javier Milei's statements about the Brazilian elections, calling them unacceptable and an attempt at foreign interference. Milei labeled Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as a 'left-wing thief' and suggested possible fraud in the electronic voting system, without providing evidence. The Brazilian government reaffirmed that the country's electoral system is secure and monitored by international observers.

item.title: MG: mercado é proibido de trocar uniformes vermelhos por camisas da Seleção
item.description: The Minas Gerais Labor Public Ministry filed a lawsuit against a market in Capinópolis that required employees to switch from red uniforms to yellow Brazilian Team shirts during the first round of the 2026 elections, a practice deemed indirect electoral harassment. The court granted an urgent injunction prohibiting the use of political symbols in the workplace and ordered the company to pay R$150,000 in collective moral damages.

item.title: “A vida dele é podre”, diz Lula sobre Flávio não abrir sigilo
item.description: President Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to release his banking and phone records, calling his life 'rotten' and accusing him of dishonesty. Lula filed a request with the TSE to break Flávio's seals, conditional on reciprocity. The request includes data from companies linked to both candidates, including an offshore firm in Portugal.

item.title: Rubel acionou Sony para tirar áudio de nordestinos anti-Lula, diz Nikolas
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira accused singer Rubel of requesting Sony to remove audio used in a video featuring testimonies from northeasterners critical of President Lula. The claim lacks independent confirmation, and the restriction may have stemmed from automatic Instagram copyright mechanisms. The controversy sparked mobilization of Flávio Bolsonaro's supporters online.

item.title: Flávio x Lula: saiba quando saem as últimas pesquisas antes do 2º turno
item.description: Seven opinion polls for the 2026 presidential runoff will be released from October 21 to 24, measuring the race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The surveys show mixed results, with Flávio leading at 52% in Real Time Big Data and Lula reaching 51% in Vox Brasil. The election takes place on October 25.

item.title: Lula lidera o debate presidencial sobre segurança pública nas redes
item.description: In the final stretch before the runoff, Lula leads the presidential debate on public security on social media with 5.99 million interactions, surpassing Flávio Bolsonaro (3.61 million). Lula's profile also leads among influencers, with 5.9 million interactions in just seven posts.

item.title: Mãe de Luciano Huck desabafa e relembra ameaças de morte ao filho gay
item.description: Marta Dora Grostein, mother of Luciano Huck, shared an emotional message about her son Fernando Grostein, who had to leave Brazil in 2019 due to death threats related to his sexual orientation. She emphasized the importance of family support for the LGBTQIA+ community.
